scope: POSTHOC CPU-only descriptive analysis of first nominal matched64/128 saved native traces. Not a new shot, qualified evidence, independent audit, perception validation or causal counterfactual. Existing capture labels and historical evidence unchanged.

method.rebound: Exact calibrated scorer rule: first contact-free force interval within50ms of board force>.01N and end-state outward normal velocity>.05m/s; rebound state is interval+1.
method.bucket: First bucket force interval>.01N at/after rebound; pre-contactstate p[k], poststate p[k+1].
method.axes: Longitudinal along board-to-bucket axis, negative is short/near side; lateral is perpendicular. No raw worldXY or joint arrays are exported.
method.after20ms: First sampled state at least20ms after first bucket contact. Force integral uses force norms times native interval duration, not vector impulse.
method.contacts: Channel counts/times stop at each original scoring terminal; unequal64/128 horizons must not be interpreted as equal-duration event-rate comparisons.
method.qualification: First nominal only; root independent audit/repeatability gates remain authoritative. Contact forces are uncalibrated simulation observations, not real material measurements.
method.postrim_crossing: First measured descending ball-center rim-plane crossing after first rim contact and before next non-bucket/non-board external contact. It may include subsequent bucket contact and is not a free-flight/clean-entry metric.

def postrim(position,force,times,board_xy,bucket_xy,rim,first_bucket_interval):
 import numpy as np
 axis=np.asarray(bucket_xy)-board_xy;axis=axis/np.linalg.norm(axis);side=np.array([-axis[1],axis[0]])
 external=np.flatnonzero((force[:,2:]>.01).any(axis=1)&(np.arange(len(force))>=first_bucket_interval))
 end=int(external[0]) if len(external) else len(position)-1
 candidates=np.arange(first_bucket_interval,end)
 cross=candidates[(position[candidates,2]>rim)&(position[candidates+1,2]<=rim)]
 value=dict(external_cutoff_time_s=float(times[end]) if len(external) else None,first_descending_center_crossing=None)
 if len(cross):
  k=int(cross[0]);fraction=float((position[k,2]-rim)/(position[k,2]-position[k+1,2]));point=position[k]+fraction*(position[k+1]-position[k]);delta=point[:2]-bucket_xy
  value["first_descending_center_crossing"]=dict(time_s=float(times[k]+fraction*(times[k+1]-times[k])),longitudinal_relative_bucket_mm=float(delta@axis*1000),lateral_relative_bucket_mm=float(delta@side*1000),radial_distance_mm=float(np.linalg.norm(delta)*1000))
 return value
